work_experience.description: Built representative procurement analytics workflows covering forecasting, supplier allocation, optimization, data pipelines, feature engineering, model evaluation, and dashboarding. The work used AWS data services, statistical forecasting, tree-based models, neural forecasting, and mathematical optimization.
Worked on optimization and operations-research problems involving MILP, CVRPTW, vehicle compatibility, and capacity and time-window constraints using Python, Gurobi, and OR-Tools.
